seoDescription: Sofiya started Silk & Velvet in 2018. Today she leads a team of four planning events and weddings, milestones, and balloon installs across NYC, Long Island, and New Jersey.
title: Four planners. One promise.
sub: Silk & Velvet started in 2018 with one event and a soft suspicion that planning could feel calmer than it usually does. Today the team is three.
